Subject: Manager pair rotation — proposed 2-quarter coverage for Greenline Labs

Hi Marissa / Marcus —

Quick note to propose a temporary manager-pair rotation for the Greenline Labs account. As discussed in last week's leadership sync, Erin has asked for more consistent coverage while their PM/eng lead transitions out of the company next quarter. To avoid a single-point handoff and to give the team continuity, I'm proposing the following:

- Marissa will act as primary for Q1 (Jan–Mar) focusing on escalation cadence and renewal ops.
- Marcus will be assigned as secondary lead for Q1, then flip to primary for Q2 (Apr–Jun) to own post-launch performance review and relationship growth.
- We’ll run a shared on-call schedule (one week primary, one week backup) and a single MAP (mutual action plan) doc that both leads update.

I've attached a short transition packet and an initial rotation summary with tentative dates and handoff checklists. This is sensitive — please keep this distribution tight until we have HR guidance from Tina and Erin is ready to communicate to her team.

Actions I need today:
1) Marissa: confirm you can take primary Jan–Mar (I know you have two launches in Feb; flag any conflicts).
2) Marcus: confirm you can be secondary during Q1 and then flip to primary in April.
3) Tina: can your team review the packet for any compliance/labor notes we should surface to Erin?

Erin — this is just an internal proposal, we’ll share a coordinated message once the rotation and dates are finalized.

Thanks all,

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
